product_one_liner.value: BombBomb is a video-engagement platform for business teams to record, send, and track personalized video messages in email, texts, LinkedIn, and other communication workflows.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page lists plan prices.

named_customers.notes: Total Expert is identified in BombBomb site materials; Zendesk publishes BombBomb as a customer case study. (Note: Zendesk itself is presented as a customer of BombBomb via its customer story.)

employee_band.notes: Built In lists 70 employees, placing BombBomb in the 51-100 band.

hq_location.notes: Company listings identify BombBomb as headquartered in Colorado Springs, Colorado.

founded_year.notes: BombBomb's LinkedIn profile and Built In profile list 2006.

eng_blog.notes: The readable company blog/news index contains news and marketing content, not at least two technical engineering posts.

public_docs.notes: BombBomb has a multi-article public help center and developer portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page has an open roles section but presents no current job titles or openings.

model_provider.notes: Product/help center and public security/company resources inspected did not identify an AI model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: BombBomb publicly states SOC 2 Type II compliance.

last_funding.notes: Funding profiles list a March 12, 2025 round of approximately $2.4 million; classifications vary across trackers, with Caplight calling it Series A.

raised_18mo.notes: The March 2025 round falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers page shows no current open job titles or listings.

launched_6mo.notes: The accessible news index did not expose dated launch history sufficient to establish whether a launch occurred within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No sufficiently complete, dated source verified whether a C-level or VP-level leader joined or left during the period.

crm_stack_signal.notes: BombBomb's public help articles document HubSpot and Salesforce integrations.
